title: John and Mable Ringling Museum of Art
geometryBasis: The named map ways locate the wall envelope and open court. Original USDA 2023 orthophotography confirms the roof planes, built additions, open sky aperture and courtyard axes.
sectionBasis: The verified Qualla atrium photo establishes the Searing Wing’s square open aperture. Daderot’s dedicated courtyard original establishes the pink plaster loggias, roof balustrades and stepped court. National Register documentation describes the rusticated east entry.
limitations: Detailed interior exhibits, the other Ringling Estate buildings and exact artwork are outside the model.
Surviving sculptural plinths and roof figures are represented with simplified shape and selected courtyard figures. Door proportions, local heights and modern cladding details are estimates.
